evidence.profile-controls: docs/research/xdma-two-word-profile.md SHA-256 6b5889d747a12538d06ccfaaa356728b6af28db5d7f18ba194251b5a12edced2 records the pinned code-4 guest profile and unchanged word fixture, response ceiling and step budget. All four width/direction controls, positive composition control and unexpected-second-access control passed before stock attachment. evidence.observation: Stock received two guarded responses at offsets 0x4048 and 0x4044. After 256 verified instruction steps, the observer exhausted its budget in guest libc pthread_mutex_unlock. Steps 20 through 255 repeat offsets 0x68cb0, 0x68cb4 and 0x68cb8, an exclusive-load/store retry sequence. There is no global-store or boundary event. The supervisor killed the process, observed status 9 and exited 72. The post-run two-word-budget verifier validates exact events, instructions against stock/libc bytes, termination and the bounded negative outcome. Ordinary two-word success verification rejects this capture. No budget extension or rerun occurred.
